scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,realtime -c auto "npm run dev -w @sim/web" "npm run dev -w @sim/realtime"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sim/shared && npm run build -w @sim/realtime && npm run build -w @sim/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sim/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sim/realtime && npm run typecheck -w @sim/web
